game_name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

verdict.tagline: A sprawling, atmospheric horror park marred by heavy technical friction.
for_you_if: you love exploring detailed horror atmospheres
you enjoy mastering challenging stealth encounters
you want to dig into custom community mods
not_for_you_if: you need stable frame rates on release hardware
you are short on storage space
you dislike losing progress to sparse checkpoints

citations.review_text:
Security Breach is really good and all, but I've found myself modding the game almost always when I play to get rid of some really annoying bugs. Ended up bricking a save once because I saved after calling Freddy and he got stuck.

Basically: Good game, but the bugs get REALLY annoying.

Maybe I should preface with the fact that I played this game completely blind. I had only just gotten engaged with FNAF again for the first time in years, playing the games I hadn't. I did not experience any media or buildup surrounding this game. Now, that said...

This game was incredibly tedious and underwhelming gameplaywise. It is also horrendously buggy. At one point I spent an hour or so walking around the area confused on what to do only to discover an event flag which was meant to trigger from me walking somewhere had not triggered. I inevitably never finished the game because I became actually softlocked due to an egregious and sudden bug later on, and I did not want to bother loading an old save. The game is also horribly optimized and has a COLOSSAL file size that does not justify itself.

On the positive end, the voice acting is good and it really manages to capture the feeling of those old pizza party arcade places from the 2000s as opposed to the 80s Showbiz/ChuckeCheese places. Felt very nostalgic. The game also has a good sense of humor and the animatronic characters have nice personality.

Overall though I would not recommend this to anyone. Its a colossal waste of time and money. I am sure there's some youtube playthrough you could watch or something that would be far more entertaining.
My whole save corrupted cause from a bug. Big L
Bugged, softlocked, have 2 female guards, don't recommend bugs don't get fixed.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe severe performance issues including heavy frame rate drops, lagging when loading into new areas, and stuttering even on lower graphical settings.

citations.review_text: LAGGY AND STUTTER, EVEN IN MEDIUM-LOW GRAPHIC

As someone who loves the FNaF games and the entire franchise, I really wanted to love this game too. I genuinely love the concept and the game itself, but the performance makes it extremely difficult to enjoy.

I have a pretty good PC and can run almost every game I play at 140+ FPS, so FPS has never really been an issue for me. But in Security Breach, I’m constantly getting anywhere from around 24 to 80 FPS, and the game feels incredibly laggy.

The worst part is that every time I load into a new area, the game starts lagging heavily. It happens over and over again, and it completely ruins the experience for me.

I really love the concept of Security Breach, and as someone who loves the FNaF franchise, I wanted to enjoy this game so badly. But unfortunately, with how poorly it runs on my PC, the game is simply unplayable for me.

I really hope the performance can be improved, because there’s a genuinely great game underneath all the performance issues.

I can't believe I used to hate this game. I watched someone on YouTube partially play it and didn't like it, then played it on PS5 and didn't like it, but for some reason going through the game and seeing everything it has to offer really made me appreciate this game, especially the DLC. Ruin was a GREAT addition, AND IT'S FREE! 
I will say my main issue was the lag. There was SOOOO much lag in this game and it got pretty obnoxious at times. I've run more high quality games on this computer with no issues (RE9, DBD, Outlast Trials) and never encountered any issues, but this game kept freezing every couple of seconds no matter how many times I adjusted the video settings.
Overall, great game! I love it so much!

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game suffers from poor optimization, requiring users to lower settings or disable ray tracing to achieve smooth performance.

citations.review_text:
I like it a lot. Kind of a strange story to it but that's not what you play FNAF games for.

The animatronics are cool but they aren't too difficult to avoid if you are patient. Monty is Dumb, Chica is slow but Roxy...She is surprisingly difficult to avoid. She's smarter and faster than the others. I wont say anything else about what else awaits you. The game starts out fairly easy but after a certain point it decides "yeah thats enough". Funnily enough its not the animatronics that are your biggest threat.

There have been some weird bugs already but nothing bad so far. seems like
a lot of the bugs it had on release are fixed. However, ALOT still remain. most aren't game breaking
and can be pretty funny but they can be really annoying as well. Especially when you're being chased.

Gameplay & mechanics, character design, even the voice acting is pretty damn good actually.
The camera mechanic is by far my favourite feature. They implemented that pretty damn well!

Edit* It turns out I am very dumb. After you reach 6am and choose to stay, you can still save. But there is only 1 save station and its located at the entrance of the Atrium as you come off the elevators. 

Here's a tip to get it running well on your PC. It seems even high end PCs have trouble running smoothly because of how poorly this game has been optimised. Turn off Ray Tracing or have it low. That solved almost all my issues. Now I can run the game with everything on High smoothly. I also recommend having view objects at a medium level at most. The game only loads map areas when you are near them but it keeps MUCH of the assets throughout the Pizzaplex loaded (as is seen when you enter an area the game hasnt loaded yet) Its an unnecessary tax on your system.

While I do like Security Breach there are a few things that can sometimes make it annoying to play things like

-No auto save (if you've been playing a while and haven't saved and you die you'll have to repeat everything you've done to that point)

-After 6am ALL save points bar one become useless making collectables and progress harder

-The security bots have a large radious making them spot you to easy hence summons the gang to appear out of no where

-Monty, Roxy & Chica will randomly spawn or despawn which can make it easyier or harder on you

-Despite being Steam Deck verified there were a lot of crashes and slowness even when playing on low settings

-The game can take 5 to 10 seconds to load between areas and the lifts takes way too long

Those are just a few things to note that i can think of while writing this, If game ever gets remastered these and many more bugs need to be fixed. Despite these negativities the game can still be fun and it has a good story, Roxy is the best.
